decisions.reason: The burner component builds directly on the firm's existing radiant-heater knowledge, so it can readily assimilate early feedback and improve it.
As a flagship electric infrared panel line, it is central to the firm's shift toward electric and renewable heating, and the firm's R&D can interpret and apply results from these models.
Electric halogen infrared heaters rely on a less-related technology and offer limited learning for the firm's integrated hall-climate systems, making this product likely to be dropped.
Industrial electric infrared hall heaters fit the firm's core hall-heating customers and service network, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn from field results.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater extends the firm's existing gas-radiant expertise into a strategic lower-carbon direction, and the early real-operation launch provides learning the firm can assimilate.
